summary: Django 3.2 → 4.2 (4.0–4.2.30): 214 risk paths (86 high, 113 medium, 15 low). Main categories: changed behavior (84), removed api (58), dependency requirement (27), configuration change (21). Most severe: Applications still using default_app_config break on Django 4.1+ (high); Calls to get_random_string() without a length argument fail on Django 4.0+ (high); Code calls undocumented django.http.multipartparser.parse_header() (high). Verified: 47 high-, 144 medium- and 23 low-confidence or disputed risks; 29 source disagreements. 5 open questions. Overall confidence: medium.

Verify the app still loads correctly under Django's app config discovery without the legacy variable
